info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Intellectual Property Portfolio Update API
info.description: The Intellectual Property Portfolio Update API enables organizations to enhance and manage their intellectual property assets effectively. Through this API, users can update specific details of knowledge assets within their intellectual property portfolio, ensuring the information remains current and relevant. Typical consumers include portfolio managers and legal teams who need to adapt asset information in response to changing business needs or legal requirements. This streamlined process improves compliance and facilitates better decision-making related to intellectual property management.

patch.description: Allows the user to modify the details of the specified intellectual property portfolio identified by RES-100045. This operation helps in maintaining accurate and up-to-date information about the assets.

requestBody.description: This request body allows for the modification of the intellectual property portfolio specified by the unique identifier RES-100045. It is essential to provide a structured JSON object conforming to the defined schema to ensure that the correct updates are processed.
